en: A black-and-white photographic portrait of a man in elaborate historical costume, likely from the 18th century, featuring a white wig, lace cravat, and decorated jacket. The text above the man's head identifies him as Willi Kleinoschegg, a royal Saxon court actor, in the role of Ferdinand. The bottom right corner credits photographer Hugo Erfurth and gives the location as Dresden.
